propositions: The resolver canonicalizes openai specs to 'openai-chat:' qualifier but the live external tier's credential map only has 'openai' entry, causing credential_present() to return False and live_llm_ready() to skip all live tests on the openai arm

The provider guard in test_provider_matrix_live.py compares resolved model specs literally against REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER='openai' (family name) but the resolver now returns 'openai-chat:' (qualifier), causing false-positive AssertionError at line 88

The unit-tier matrix gate _MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER was updated in commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 to map qualifiers to families, but the live external tier consumers were not updated, creating an unmet obligation

The fix maps qualifier->family in _live_llm.py via _PROVIDER_FAMILY_BY_QUALIFIER and updates guard comparisons to use provider_family() so credential lookup, readiness checks, and arm equality assertions all agree on the family name
Unit regression tests verify that configured_provider() returns the family and live_llm_ready() is True on the openai arm with the overlay and credential present
The guard retains its protective purpose—specs resolving to a different family (e.g. anthropic on openai arm) still fail, so the fix removes a false positive without weakening validation
